name: STS1 Engine Solver
description: Combat solver for Slay the Spire 1: it mirrors the live combat engine into an isolated copy, runs the game's own card, relic, potion and monster code on that copy, and searches the real states. Nothing is re-modelled by hand, so there is no per-card table to keep in sync. Compatibility: works in theory with any mod that adds content (cards, relics, potions, characters, monsters, events) without changing how combat itself resolves.
